declared.title: Income and emotional well-being: A conflict resolved
declared.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
declared.foundIn: Crossref search « income and emotional well-being a conflict resolved adversarial collaboration » (2026-11-22)

population: reanalysis of Killingsworth 2021's experience-sampling data: employed US adults

findings.text: The plateau of day-to-day happiness exists, but only for the least happy people

support.sentence: A reanalysis of Killingsworth's experienced sampling data confirmed the flattening pattern only for the least happy people.

findings.text: For everyone else, day-to-day happiness keeps rising with income, and rises even faster for the happiest

support.sentence: Happiness increases steadily with log(income) among happier people, and even accelerates in the happiest group.

limits: an adversarial collaboration between the two opposing authors: a strength, but a reanalysis of one existing dataset, not new data
an association: income is not manipulated
the abstract gives neither the income of the plateau nor the share of « least happy » people: no such number may be quoted from this sheet
employed US adults using a smartphone app: not representative
